Title: Misleading discount promise and Unresolved Billing Issue, 25% Discount Not Honoured & Unauthorised Payment Pressure || Body: Misleading discount promise and extremely disappointing customer experience

I had a very disappointing experience with Tumbledry and feel that their advertising and sales communication were highly misleading.

When I placed my first order (T5265), I understood from Tumbledry's website/app that I would receive a flat 20% instant discount on my first order. I therefore expected the discount to be reflected directly in the bill.

However, the bill was initially generated for the full amount of ₹3,090, without the promised 20% discount. When I contacted customer support, I was told that the issue would be resolved/adjusted, but instead of simply honouring the advertised offer, the customer-care team convinced me to purchase a ₹3,500 package, claiming that I would get a 25% discount.

I relied on their representation and purchased the package. In hindsight, I feel that I was effectively persuaded to buy a package when I was initially only seeking the 20% first-order discount that had been advertised.

The subsequent handling of the billing and wallet balance made the situation even more frustrating. The calculation involved a 25% discount on the ₹3,090 bill, with the remaining amount being adjusted through the wallet/package mechanism, rather than the straightforward first-order discount I had originally expected.

What particularly disappoints me is not merely the monetary amount involved, but the manner in which the issue was handled. When a customer approaches support because an advertised offer has not been applied, the reasonable expectation is that the company will honour the advertised offer clearly and transparently—not use the situation to sell a higher-value package.

I feel I was led into purchasing the ₹3,500 package after being initially attracted by the advertised 20% first-order discount. The experience has left me feeling misled and extremely dissatisfied.

Tumbledry should provide much greater transparency regarding:

What exactly the first-order discount covers;
Whether the discount is applied directly to the first invoice;
How wallet/package balances are calculated;
Whether customer-care representatives are expected to sell packages when customers raise billing disputes; and
Why the advertised offer was not simply honoured on the original order.

I am sharing this review so that other customers can carefully check the actual billing and terms of promotional offers before making a payment or purchasing a package.

Overall: Very disappointing experience. The issue was not just the amount involved—it was the lack of transparency and the way the matter was handled by customer support.

When I asked to cancel, I was told the curtains had already been sent to the Noida processing plant without my approval, leaving me with no option but to proceed.

The curtains were returned with visible smudges and poor finishing. Four curtains had to be sent back again. One curtain also came back damaged after reprocessing.

To make matters worse, instead of resolving the issue professionally, I received repeated calls from the plant denying responsibility.

This entire experience involved:

Misquotation
Aggressive staff behaviour
Unauthorized processing
Inflated billing
Poor cleaning quality
Curtain damage
Extremely poor customer handling

The matter is STILL unresolved.

I would strongly advise people to think carefully before using Tumbledry services.

Title: Extremely disappointing experience with Tumbledry || Body: The issue was not the revised ₹120 charge. I was willing to pay the revised amount and had clearly asked them to proceed with washing my clothes.During the conversation, I simply said that I would leave a Google review based on my experience. In response, the staff themselves said, “If you are giving bad review, then why should we wash?” They then told me to come to the store and collect my clothes. When I questioned this, they said they could return the clothes but I would have to pay ₹50 for delivery.I find it completely unacceptable that a paying customer is told that their clothes will not be washed simply because they may leave a negative review. A customer is entitled to give an honest review of their experience, whether it is positive or negative.What makes this experience even worse is that a message containing abusive language was also sent to me from their side and was subsequently deleted. I have retained the conversation and screenshots.I am attaching screenshots of the entire conversation with this review because I expect there may be an attempt to provide a different explanation or justification later. I would rather let the screenshots speak for themselves.To be clear, this review is not about ₹120 or about a disagreement over pricing. It is about the way a customer was spoken to, the refusal to provide the service based on the review I said I would leave, and the inappropriate language used during the conversation.Very disappointing customer service as well. I raised a complaint but there were no follow ups. Given the high pricing and overall poor service quality, I don’t recommend this app
